answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the quartz queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The mirror index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1793 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. A 473 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
